description: This source file defines the CatalogItem entity class within the eShopWeb application's core domain. It includes properties related to catalog items, methods for updating item details, brand, type, picture URI, and a nested record struct for item details.

classes.name: CatalogItem
classes.description: An entity representing a catalog item with properties for name, description, price, picture URI, and related catalog type and brand identifiers. Includes methods to update these properties.

methods.name: CatalogItem
methods.description: Constructor to initialize a new catalog item with specific type, brand, description, name, price, and picture URI.

methods.name: UpdateDetails
methods.description: Updates the catalog item's name, description, and price after validating inputs.

methods.name: UpdateBrand
methods.description: Updates the catalog brand ID, validating that it is not zero.

methods.name: UpdateType
methods.description: Updates the catalog type ID, validating that it is not zero.

methods.name: UpdatePictureUri
methods.description: Updates the picture URI, setting it to a formatted path if a non-empty filename is provided, or resetting it if empty.

methods.name: CatalogItemDetails
methods.description: A record struct encapsulating details of a catalog item, including name, description, and price.
